name: Foreach
description: Execute a saved child graph for each item in an input collection.

inputs.name: items
inputs.label: Items
inputs.helpText: Array of items or an object containing an items array.

inputs.name: baseInput
inputs.label: Base Input
inputs.helpText: Optional base object passed to every item run. Note: 'item', 'index', and 'total' are reserved and automatically generated.

inputs.name: maxIterations
inputs.label: Max Iterations
inputs.helpText: Maximum number of items to process (1 to 100).

inputs.name: concurrency
inputs.label: Concurrency
inputs.helpText: Number of child graph executions to run in parallel (1 to 10).

inputs.name: stopOnError
inputs.label: Stop On Error
inputs.helpText: If enabled, stops initiating new child runs after the first failure.

inputs.name: outputType
inputs.label: Child Output Type
inputs.helpText: Describes child graph result for downstream autocomplete.
